integrity: Analytic derivation; numerical checks only corroborative; no independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed ambient dimension and number of caps; only a prescribed great circle, not the whole sphere. Finite-epsilon beta law is not asserted. Historical priority provisional because Siegel–Holst (1982) full text was unavailable; its general random-arc probability already covers the scalar integral framework.
title: Near-critical coverage of a great circle by independent spherical caps: a sharp onset and a Beta–Dirichlet shape law
